title: From the Fair Distribution of Predictions to the Fair Distribution of Social Goods: Evaluating the Impact of Fair Machine Learning on Long-Term Unemployment*
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith. Its focus is on algorithmic fairness concerning gender and citizenship in the context of long-term unemployment.
